title: Overthrown Keeper of the Candies
description: Overthrown Keeper of the Candies — The Townstons wiki
html:
Overthrown Keeper of the Candies

The Overthrown Keeper of the Candies looks like a giant rainbow Yummy Yum. It can be found in the Candy Vault within the offs of Mutanous Malaise. It is listed as an NPC, however, it will attack when approached and can be killed like a monster. It is essentially a champion Mutant Hulk with a different appearance. It is kept behind a gate that can be opened by an attack or by a Yummy Yum monster.

Rose and, believe it or not, Dorcas give the Yummy Yums Candy Run guest.
